subject: Buying path assessment and vendor intake next steps
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Sasha Cole <sasha.cole@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-29T15:12:00-08:00
Subject: Buying path assessment and vendor intake next steps

Hi Sasha — great conversation earlier. Quick recap and recommended next steps on procurement readiness so your team can route this internally. TL;DR: Redwood can support both card and PO billing; we have a vendor packet for your finance team, and we can activate Acme in our vendor portal to deliver invoices/PO matching if you prefer a PO flow.

Recap from discovery:
- Use-case: customer-facing search assistant + downstream analytics; expected steady throughput (300–600 reqs/day) and occasional spikes during promotions.
- Data residency: US-only.
- Security: SOC2 + customer-managed VPC options discussed — fine for Acme's requirements.

Procurement options and asks:
1) Card vs Purchase Order
   - Card: fastest (can go live in 1–2 business days) and supported for usage-based billing.
   - PO (net-30/45): supported via our billing team — requires vendor setup + signed SOW/order form. If you want net terms, finance will need vendor packet + W-9 and banking info.
2) Marketplace billing
   - We are listed on the MajorCloud Marketplace, which some customers use for consolidated billing. If Acme prefers marketplace, let us know — fees and timing differ (usually longer onboarding).
3) Vendor packet / vendor portal
   - I attached the vendor packet (pdf) and our completed W-9 for your team. We can also create a vendor portal account for Acme to upload PO numbers and retrieve invoices.

Proposed next steps (pick one):
A) Fast path: Pay-by-card to start pilot this week — I’ll send invoice details and a card authorization link.
B) Procurement path: If you need PO + net terms, please share the vendor setup form (or portal link) and point of contact at finance; I’ll loop in our finance lead (Aditya) to confirm banking and net terms.
C) Marketplace: If you want marketplace billing, confirm which marketplace and we’ll schedule a short call with our partnerships team.

Please let me know which route you prefer and I’ll move the paperwork. If you want me to share the packet with your vendor portal directly, reply with the portal URL and a contact.

Attachments:
- Redwood Vendor Packet (redwood_vendor_packet_20261201.pdf)
- Redwood W-9 (W9_redwood_signed.pdf)

Thanks — Jordan
Jordan Blake
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Thanks Jordan — very helpful summary. A few clarifying items from procurement/finance: 

1) Vendor packet — please confirm whether the vendor packet can be uploaded into our Coupa instance (we have a vendor portal integration). If you can’t upload, we’ll need the packet emailed to vendor-setup@acme-corp.com.
2) Banking details — does Redwood provide ACH details in the vendor packet or will those be shared after PO issuance?
3) Tax forms — the W-9 looks fine; can you confirm the EIN on the W-9 matches Redwood’s legal entity used for billing?
4) Net terms — procurement is asking whether Redwood is open to net-30 with standard Master Services Agreement (MSA) redlines.
5) Marketplace — we may prefer Marketplace billing if onboarding time is acceptable; can you share the differences in fees and timeline?

Would it help to have a short three-way call (procurement + finance + Redwood) tomorrow morning? If yes, propose 10:00–10:30 PT.

Thanks,
Sasha Cole
Director, Strategic Procurement | Acme Corp
sasha.cole@acme-corp.com

2) Banking: Our vendor packet includes our primary ACH instructions; we also provide banking via our finance portal for PO payment matching.
3) W-9 EIN: Confirmed — the EIN on the attached W-9 is for Redwood Inference, Inc., and matches our billing entity. I’ll attach a second copy with the EIN highlighted for your team.
4) Net terms / MSA: We are open to net-30 with standard redlines — I’ve looped in Aditya (Finance) to confirm final approvals and any KYC requirements.
5) Marketplace vs direct: Marketplace onboarding typically adds 2–3 weeks and marketplace fees are variable (I can share a short comparison doc on the call).

If procurement wants to proceed with PO flow, next actionable items for Acme finance: share vendor-portal upload or vendor form, indicate desired net terms, and confirm point of contact for PO issuance.

I’ll send a calendar invite for 10:00 PT tomorrow with call details.

Thanks — Jordan
